lessons: The coverage gate failed: clutch/ioguard.py had 48.10% coverage against a 90% floor, with lines 31-52 and 66 missing. All tests passed, so redo the full ticket scope and add unit-test coverage of those lines in tests/unit/test_ioguard.py. Do not lower the floor in test-gate.toml.

CPython runs sys.addaudithook callbacks with tracing paused unless the hook has a truthy __cantrace__ attribute. Coverage therefore never records the hook body even when tests trigger it. Put the event decision in a pure function in clutch/ioguard.py, e.g. (event, args, basetemp) -> operation or

In tests/unit/test_ioguard.py, call that pure decision function directly for each case: open write/append/create/exclusive/O_TMPFILE, os.rename/replace/remove/unlink/rmdir, shutil events, os.mkdir inside and outside basetemp, the *current symlink carve-out, subprocess.Popen, os.system,

Also keep the end-to-end tests from the acceptance criteria that enter guard(tmp_path) and assert IntegrationIOBlocked is raised and nothing is left on disk. Make sure the duckdb.connect raise for an on-disk database (likely line 66) runs in a unit test.

Before you finish, run the gate's own command, not just the Verification commands: `uv run clutch coverage gate -- uv run python -m pytest tests/unit -p clutch.testguard --cov=clutch --cov-branch --cov-report=json:coverage.json -n auto`. Confirm clutch/ioguard.py is at 90% or above.
